name: Power Shift
source:
In a post-apocalyptic world, two androids struggle to survive with only one functional battery between them. They take turns being "alive," communicating through memory chip recordings left for each other. 

As they navigate the desolate landscape and post-apocalyptic cities, their bond evolves, and the player guides their relationship towards one of three possible endings : a strong friendship, a romantic partnership, or a bitter rivalry. 

Will they find a way to preserve their connection, or will the last charge of their battery be consumed by hatred?

[From [url=https://rossaredflyn.itch.io/power-shift]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
在一个后世界末日的世界里，两个机器人在只有一块可用电池的情况下挣扎着生存。他们轮流“活着”，通过彼此留下的记忆芯片录音进行交流。

当他们穿越荒凉的风景和后世界末日的城市时，他们的关系不断发展，玩家引导他们的关系走向三种可能的结局之一：牢固的友谊、浪漫的伙伴关系或激烈的竞争。

他们会找到一种方法来保持联系，还是会因为仇恨而耗尽最后的电量？

[来自[url=https://rossaredflyn.itch.io/power-shift]itch.io[/url]]
